modules.name: Minimal Nation
modules.description: One big knob, one input, one output. The signal passes straight through and the knob does nothing. It just looks good.

modules.name: Poltergeist
modules.description: A ghost that moves your real cables: on each HAUNT it swaps two cables, moves one to another socket or makes one vanish for a while, only inside a fence of modules to its right. EXORCISE puts everything back, and every move can be undone with Ctrl+Z.
